description: tether/pretty.py renders tether/status.py check results into the Rich human-facing TTY view; its per-state branches (the HEALTHY/DRIFTED/BROKEN color mapping, the attention-table cells, DRIFTED and normalization-rescued diff panels, BROKEN rename-candidate panels) track status.py's state model and ArtifactCheck shape. A new aggregate/artifact state or a new ArtifactCheck field needs matching presentation in pretty.py, or it is silently omitted from the pretty status/show/refs output. Parallels the render.py<->status.py tether for the plain-markdown surface.
